purpose: Compare independent Mississippi state hospital-directory editions to bound the Neshoba Acute-to-CAH classification transition without treating state type as Medicare CCN-effective evidence.

state_sources.agency: Mississippi State Department of Health, Health Facilities Licensure and Certification
state_sources.web_reader_evidence: Search-indexed official PDF row: Neshoba County General Hospital; type Acute; 1001 Holland Avenue; Philadelphia, MS 39350; license 11-227; 48 beds.
state_sources.direct_retrieval: Earlier published PDF edition; not newly downloaded in this review.

state_sources.agency: Mississippi State Department of Health, Health Facilities Licensure and Certification
state_sources.observed_row: Neshoba County General Hospital; type CAH; 1001 Holland Avenue; Philadelphia, MS 39350; license 11-227; Neshoba County; 48 licensed beds; 48 acute beds; 10 geriatric-psychiatric beds; DNV; acute-bed note; former name Northwest Regional.
state_sources.retrieval_retention: The complete PDF was downloaded to a temporary file and hash-calculated; the temporary copy was not retained in the project. Re-fetch/re-hash is required for byte-level reproducibility.

correlated_evidence.cms_pos_observation: Q1 2026 POS lists CCN 250043 with termination/expiration 2025-12-31 and CCN 251340 with original participation date 2026-01-01.
correlated_evidence.first_party_transition_statement: reconciliation-neshoba-cah-transition-page-recheck-proof-2026-09-25.json records the hospital's planned CAH conversion date of 2025-10-01; that page describes intent/planning, not a completed CMS effective date.
correlated_evidence.cms_successor_row: Current CMS records identify 251340 as the active CAH at the same 1001 Holland Avenue campus.

interpretation: The independent state directory editions bracket a state hospital-type change: Acute by May 05, 2025 and CAH by September 18, 2026, at the same licensed facility/address. CMS POS separately records a Medicare CCN 250043 termination/expiration boundary of 2025-12-31 and CCN 251340 original participation date 2026-01-01. The state-directory bracket is not the effective date, does not prove which historic CMS MRF was published before 2025-12-31, and does not link any MRF to either CCN.
next_action: Preserve 250043 in the historical accountability baseline. Seek dated pre-2025-12-31 CMS pointer/MRF bytes from a materially new archive/source or a separately retained publisher file. Keep the complete June 2026 current-campus CMS 3.0.0 file unassigned between the historical 250043 and successor 251340 until exact file scope is documented. Do not repeat prior Common Crawl/Wayback routes or Q1 2026 POS queries absent source/index/version change.
